title: Exploration of key genes associated with oxidative stress in polycystic ovary syndrome and experimental validation
summary: The study integrates four PCOS gene-expression datasets, WGCNA and RF/SVM/GLM feature selection and reports seven oxidative-stress genes; RT-qPCR in an independent sample confirmed expression trends for IFNG, DDIT3 and APOA1. This is exploratory molecular evidence; the predicted therapeutics are not experimentally validated.
